title: A tone
text: An oscillator makes the raw sound: here a saw wave, at the pitch of the key you play (MIDI In's PITCH into the oscillator's PITCH), straight to the Output. It never stops: there's nothing yet to turn it off between notes. Try: move the cable from SAW to PULSE, TRIANGLE, SINE and hear each wave (right-click the output to see it on the scope). Turn OCTAVE. With PULSE, turn WIDTH.
